name: Automate It!

pick.label: Pick a job
pick.heading: Pick a boring job and build an AI to do it
lead: Everybody says AI is going to take over the boring jobs. Fine. Let’s choose which ones.
Pick a task you would happily never do again, and invent the AI that does it for you. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *Bonus points if it would definitely go wrong.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: Obviously I am not looking for a real product here, this is just for a bit of fun. Some of these AIs would make you a fortune, and some would get you banned from the Bürgeramt. Both are welcome.

rows: Which boring job are you never doing again?
Give your AI a name. Something friendly, or something terrifying.
What does it actually do, step by step? Does it talk, watch, listen, send emails…?
Who would pay for it? Students, landlords, tired parents, the whole of Berlin?
The day it makes a mistake. What happens, and who has to sort it out?
Who do you get to talk about it, and where?

values.name: BürgerBot
values.how: It sits on the Bürgeramt booking website 24 hours a day, refreshing the page every three seconds, and grabs the first free appointment anywhere in Berlin. Then it sends you a calendar invitation and a little message of congratulations.
values.who: Everyone who has just moved to Berlin, and everyone who has lived here for ten years and still hasn’t registered their new address.
values.wrong: It gets a bit too good at its job and books 400 appointments, all in Marzahn at 7.15 on a Tuesday. The city blocks my account, and I have to go in person to apologise. Without an appointment.
values.promote: Posters in every U-Bahn station, and a free appointment for the first hundred people who sign up. Word of mouth does the rest: in Berlin, nobody keeps a free appointment secret.
